text.zh: 在临海步道的岔口放置一块无文字、仅有方向箭头的引导牌。
text.en: Place a single trail marker at the coastal fork, bearing only a directional arrow and no lettering.

text.zh: 用雾夜石径和短石墙延续沿岸系列的空间。
text.en: Continue the coastal series with a foggy night path and a short stone wall.

text.zh: 让观众看清岔路的去向。
text.en: Let the viewer read the direction of the fork.

text.zh: 夜间低饱和冷灰蓝的海雾与石面占主导，稀少琥珀暖色贴近步道牌的岔口箭头。
text.en: Make low-saturation cool blue-gray night fog and stone dominant; keep scarce amber close to the fork arrow on the trail marker.

text.zh: 箭头尖和牌面一条短边清楚连续，石墙和海雾边缘疏断并融入冷色块。
text.en: Keep the arrow tip and one short edge of the sign continuous and crisp; break and merge the stone-wall and mist edges into cool masses.

text.zh: 把牌面箭头和少量湿石粒作为局部细节，背景岩壁与雾只画低密度色面。
text.en: Focus local detail on the arrow and a few wet stone grains; use low-density color planes for the rock face and fog.

text.zh: 由低反差的石板小径和短墙指向岔路牌，让箭头、琥珀色反光和最清楚短边形成一个落点。
text.en: Use the low-contrast stone path and short wall to lead to the fork marker, aligning the arrow, amber reflection, and clearest short edge at one focus.

text.zh: 大暗色面轻微呈现细纸粒，并保持主视觉细节清楚。
text.en: Let fine paper grain show subtly on broad dark areas, with focal details kept clear.
